post.originalText:
tested claude Opus 5.5 on a 3D build

the prompt: "generate a mechanical wasp for me"

What it built:

> 6 jointed legs
> 4 veined wings with motion blur
> spinning gearbox in the thorax
> retractable stinger
> a full exploded view

then it rendered the video for me

the render was slow, had to hit "continue" a couple times

Still… Opus is cooking
